steps.heading: Search everything you've collected
steps.text: One box searches papers, patents, slides, cached answers — and everything you've made. It's the same query the LLM runs; each result shows the single best-matching passage from that source.

steps.heading: + New
steps.text: Create a CAD part, a DFT cell, a figure, a diagram — or a draft. Pick draft and two fields matter: the description becomes the writer's initial prompt (not a summary — it's what the model reads first and returns to on every pass), and genre sets the register and section scaffold.

steps.heading: Folders
steps.text: File anything into a folder tree, or leave it unfiled and find it by search instead. "Anywhere" drops the folder scope so a kind's list still matches its real total.

steps.heading: Tag filter
steps.text: Type to autocomplete a tag, click to add it as a chip — narrows the list to items carrying every tag you've selected.
